book_title: 小蓝本高中卷4 均值不等式与柯西不等式
stem_md: 记 $a = BC$, $b = AC$, $c = AB$, $S = S_{\triangle ABC}$, $S_0 = S_{\triangle DEF}$. 由三角形平分线的性质, 得 $\frac{AF}{b} = \frac{BF}{a} = \frac{AF + BF}{b + a} = \frac{c}{a + b}$. 从而 $AF = \frac{bc}{a + b}$, 同理可得 $AE = \frac{bc}{a + c}$. 因此, $S_{\triangle AEF} = \frac{1}{2} AF \cdot AE \sin \angle BAC = \frac{1}{2} bc \sin \angle BAC \cdot \frac{bc}{(a + b)(a + c)} = \frac{bcS}{(a + b)(a + c)}$. 同理可得 $S_{\triangle BDF} = \frac{acS}{(a + b)(b + c)}$, $S_{\triangle CDE} = \frac{abS}{(a + c)(b + c)}$. 由平均值不等式, 得 $S - S_0 = S_{\triangle AEF} + S_{\triangle BDF} + S_{\triangle CDE} = \left[\frac{bc}{(a + b)(a + c)} + \frac{ac}{(b + a)(b + c)} + \frac{ab}{(c + a)(c + b)}\right]S \geq \frac{6abcS}{(a + b)(b + c)(c + a)} = 3\left[1 - \frac{bc}{(a + b)(a + c)} - \frac{ac}{(a + b)(c + b)} - \frac{ab}{(a + c)(c + b)}\right]S = 3(S - S_{\triangle AEF} - S_{\triangle BDF} - S_{\triangle CDE}) = 3S_0$. 于是, $S_0 \leq \frac{1}{4}S$, 即命题成立.
